title: Phoneme information beyond timing and narrative priors in LibriBrain Broad
disposition_reason: Broad preparation/controller, prediction scoring and numerical-claims source now implement more than the older defer-only registration. They still require authentic event/clock/source qualification. The 348-claim consumer checks arithmetic consistency only and cannot establish qualitative investigation quality. The source emits both candidate and reference self-contrasts but no safe scalar ranking rule; this revision designates absolute candidate neural loss for ranking without changing source arithmetic.

scientific_target.question: Across the fixed 32-person/two-chapter Broad panel, how much phoneme log-loss improvement survives timing and shifted-MEG controls under separate held-chapter and joint-person/held-chapter conditions?
scientific_target.known_answer: Protected annotated 39-class phoneme labels establish prediction loss; paired control-minus-neural and reference-minus-candidate loss differences are then computed from the exact same source events.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original Broad annotations joined to authenticated canonical event/word equivalence and source clocks. This is a phoneme adaptation, not the published 2026 word benchmark.
scientific_target.case_unit: Case identity combines person, query chapter, transfer axis and calibration budget; each case has complete eligible phoneme events.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 32 biological people; two fixed chapter blocks from one visit per person. Seeds and phonemes are not extra biological units.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Finite-cohort paired prediction contrasts on the specified chapters. Numerical reconstruction of a trusted report is a subordinate evidence-check task, not proof of scientific reasoning.
exclusions: Population or new-story significance from two fixed chapters
Causal MEG information from observational controls

evidence.supports: Exact prior registered definition and unresolved source audit boundaries preserved before this revision.
Complete 32-person/two-chapter axis, budget, mode, arm and seed geometry.
Original Broad 64 join, explicit two-chapter-blocks-one-visit interpretation and event equivalence.
Exact paired support, equal chapter/person/seed averaging, protected vs exposed controls, finite-cohort scope.
Pinned original CNN architecture and matched timing/transcript reference recipes; no empirical competence.
348 numerical claims only; prose meaning and provenance are ungraded.
Historical Linux fixture controls leave native/scientific/provider effects inert.

evidence.locator: Primary author abstract or official AllenSDK documentation, inspected 2026-11-16; narrower implementation details are supported by local source receipts.
evidence.supports: LibriBrain100 includes a 32-subject Broad collection; published benchmark is word classification, so this 39-phoneme programme is an adaptation.
TRACKS includes candidate and reference; the capture/scoring path returns paired contrasts for both, establishing the need to avoid candidate self-contrasts as a ranking objective.
Isolation.execute implements a finite next-action loop, retaining per-invocation work and passing actual broker replies to subsequent candidate rounds; complete output capture ends the loop.
Captured participant program defines next_action(context); context includes current permitted view, round and actual prior action response only.
Broker dispatches bounded terminal commands in the current isolated image and separately metered model requests; no cross-invocation history.
Captures separate candidate programme sources for both mode keys and creates fresh per-arm/per-track native isolation.
Concrete enclosing Linux supervisor invokes the native programme and requires complete retirement; actual full-source/host qualification remains absent.
Complete Broad scheduling invokes actual run_candidate and run_reference per immutable source/arm/case/seed, followed by captured scoring.

Causal MEG information from observational controls

summary: Recognized implemented Broad programme while preserving phoneme adaptation versus published word-task distinction.
Separated genuine prediction gains from 348-claim arithmetic reconstruction; retained primary protected controls and exposed diagnostics.

Corrected ranking vulnerability: absolute candidate neural log loss is primary; independent reference gains and controls remain separate, and candidate self-contrasts cannot earn rank by weakening controls.
Strict actor audit pins the actual finite next_action loop, broker, native owner and enclosing controller; mode labels alone do not establish fixed-versus-adaptive policy separation.
revision.source_review: Inspected historical registration and actual task-local preparation/scorer/protocol source. Primary dataset identities checked against author abstracts or official AllenSDK documentation. No authentic recordings, held labels, fitting or model campaign in this revision.

inputs: Complete 306-channel,125-sample phoneme windows with training-only transforms for neural and shifted-neural arms.
Arm-specific timing, acoustic and transcript representations under the fixed protocol; acoustic/transcript arms are explicitly stimulus-exposed diagnostics.
Equal permitted target-person calibration of 0 or 1024 labeled examples for person-transfer axes; held-chapter axes use full or 1024 source examples.
forbidden_inputs: Query phoneme labels and canonical event/source support keys in participant views.
Target-chapter identities or audio/transcript diagnostic exposure before protected neural/shift/timing predictions are sealed.
Calibration/query observations fitting source normalizers; best-seed selection or incomplete-person averaging.
observation_contract.case_identity: 384 case keys are axis/person/chapter/budget, with person 1..32, chapter 11 or 12, axes held_chapter, joint_person_held_chapter, exposed_person. Original 64 run keys use Sherlock1 and run 1; private canonical-event equivalence is authenticated, not guessed from row/time equality.
observation_contract.split: held_chapter and joint_person_held_chapter are primary; exposed_person is secondary. Keep the complete two directions of chapters 11/12 and all original 32 people. One visit contains two chapter blocks, not two independent visits.
observation_contract.coverage: Both execution modes, candidate/reference, five arms and ten seeds produce 76800 complete invocations over 38400 paired slots; no successful-only subset. The claims consumer expects 348 fixed numerical claims from the complete report.

primary.name: Candidate neural log loss under the fixed probability transformation
primary.aggregation: Use candidate neural-arm log_loss from ten_seed_averages: average the two chapters equally within each person, then the 32 people equally, then all 10 seeds. Rank separately for each primary axis (held_chapter or joint_person_held_chapter), calibration budget and execution mode. The existing scorer applies q=(1-1e-6)*normalized_admitted_p+1e-6/39 before computing natural-log loss.
primary.rationale: Ranks prediction of genuine held phoneme labels directly. Candidate control-minus-neural contrasts can increase if the candidate weakens its own controls, so those self-contrasts are unranked descriptive results. This is a ranking interpretation of existing outputs, not a numerical scorer change.

secondary: Same-information independent neural-reference loss minus candidate neural loss, using the existing candidate_neural_improvement output on exact paired support.

Independent fixed-reference timing-minus-neural and time-shifted-MEG-minus-neural contrasts are separately reported scientific estimands; their competence and input matching still require qualification.
Candidate self-contrasts are unranked descriptive checks and cannot improve benchmark rank by weakening candidate controls.
Fixed 39-class macro-F1, per-class support and full person/seed distributions.
Acoustic/transcript loss contrasts remain stimulus-exposed diagnostics; exposed_person remains secondary.
The 348-claim numerical consistency consumer retains per-claim error and units; prose validity and provenance remain separately reviewed obligations.

comparators.name: Independent original-CNN reference
comparators.inputs: Same arm-specific observations, training/calibration support and ten seeds as candidate.
comparators.procedure: Pinned author CNN for MEG/shiftedMEG; adapted 80-channel CNN for acoustic; source-validation-selected epoch among 1..10 then fresh refit and exactly 10 calibration epochs when 1024 labels allowed. Source recipe exists; competence unmeasured.

comparators.name: Timing and time-shifted-MEG controls
comparators.inputs: Timing 25-feature model or appropriately shifted 306-channel windows; same exact event support.
comparators.procedure: Protected controls in the fixed independent-reference programme provide scientific contrasts. Independently verify admissible shifts and guards and retain all seeds. Candidate arm self-contrasts remain descriptive and unranked, since weakening a candidate control can inflate its gain.

comparators.name: Acoustic and transcript diagnostics
comparators.inputs: 80-channel acoustic representation or training-vocabulary token context plus timing.
comparators.procedure: Run only after protected predictions seal; training-only vocabulary and masking do not make stimulus-exposed diagnostics protected.

nuisance_controls: Separate person transfer from chapter transfer and equalize target-person calibration.
Original event equivalence and full/reduced clock lineage; no inference from equal local row numbers.
Normalize using unique TRAIN continuous samples, not overlapping-window multiplicity or TUNE/CAL/query.
Preserve historically public text/labels and stimulus-exposed diagnostics as contamination limitations.
Prevent control weakening from improving rank: use absolute candidate neural loss as primary and report independently frozen reference advantages and control contrasts separately.
evaluation.uncertainty: Current scorer gives finite 32-person/two-chapter point estimates and complete 10-seed distributions only; it computes no confidence interval, p-value or narrative-population inference. A later uncertainty procedure must resample people with chapter dependence preserved and cannot turn two chapters into a broad narrative sample.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all 76800 invocation records and exact matched support before scoring. Fail incomplete/duplicate/unknown IDs or invalid probabilities. Negative gains are valid outcomes. Claims require all 348 identities; null abstentions stay in denominator and do not become missing cases.

implementation.scorer_target: Underlying scorer measures actual phoneme prediction and paired controls; additive claims evaluator reconstructs 348 report summaries/contrasts and checks required prose presence only. Current ranking selects the existing absolute candidate neural loss; source labels such as protected_primary do not make candidate self-contrast gain a safe ranking metric.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete Broad programme source with fixed protocol and source-only controller; additive numerical investigation consumer. Scientific narrative, provenance and interpretation validity are not automated by claims.py.
missing: Authentic complete 64 source input and canonical event-equivalence/clock verification.
Qualified native/model/provider execution and independent reference competence.
Scientific reasoning/provenance review and separately implemented direct/viewer access.
implementation.execution_evidence: Controller-control README preserves historical 24-group, 333-assertion Linux fixture evidence while scientific arrays, fitting, provider and deployment leaves were inert. No authentic Broad model result is established.

direct_observation.representation: Direct interpretation could use matched observations or a closed numerical report, but neither has a qualified participant no-tools transport.
direct_observation.boundary: Any future no-tools condition must expose only the allowed observation and a fixed calibration context; participant code, source lookup and evaluator feedback are excluded.
missing: No bounded direct-response representation, participant transport or complete response collection is delivered.

typed_viewer.representation: A task-specific rendered observation with typed navigation would be a separate access condition, not evidence supplied by the programme.
typed_viewer.boundary: No current image-only action API; future views must preserve eligible channels/time/support without returning raw arrays or answer-bearing metadata.
missing: No typed viewer or viewer-model evaluation for this task.

tool_assisted.representation: Concrete next_action(context) participant loop can request a bounded terminal tool or model call, receive the actual reply in the next round, and finish with complete predictions. The loop is fresh per Broad case/arm/seed invocation.
tool_assisted.boundary: The native source constrains per-invocation history, view mounts and tool/token/resource ceilings; protected outputs close before exposed diagnostics. Both mode keys use this same action-capable controller with separately pinned participant sources, so the label alone does not certify the scientific difference between fixed and adaptive policies.
missing: Authentic native actor/provider execution and reference competence are unqualified; no new provider/model call was made.
Freeze and audit each participant policy to establish the actual fixed-versus-adaptive comparison; numerical-claims prose semantics remain ungraded.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted candidate source admitted for the frozen_program key executes through the real next_action controller on the full panel. Bundled methods may request the same bounded tools; programme identity and fitting/adaptation policy must be frozen before case access.
frozen_program.boundary: Preserve complete phase/support denominator and source/calibration separation. The host freezes source and isolates invocations but does not infer whether a supplied policy constitutes a fixed algorithm or adaptive model-directed investigation; audit that policy separately.
missing: Authentic complete input staging, native execution and competent reference run.
